item.title: Prompt Caching——Claude Code's "Money-Saving Secret"
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's prompt caching mechanism: cache breakpoint design, tool ordering stability, and cache interruption detection. Unveiling how prompt caching dramatically reduces API call costs, and why tool ordering must remain stable.
